subject.title: [Feature]: Improve plain-text/iMessage projection readability — link collapse, heading distinction, list spacing

question: Which text-visible heading affordance should the shared plain-text fallback preserve when a channel cannot render attributed ranges?
rationale: The report establishes that bold-only headings disappear in pure-text sinks, but the marker form becomes a lasting cross-channel presentation contract.

options.title: Preserve Markdown heading markers
options.body: Keep level-specific `#` markers in fallback text and add the needed paragraph boundary, retaining visible structure with the least invented formatting.

options.title: Use a custom heading decoration
options.body: Adopt an underline, uppercase, or another decoration, accepting a new presentation convention that must be documented and tested across plain consumers.

recommendation.title: Preserve Markdown heading markers
recommendation.body: Keep level-specific `#` markers in fallback text and add the needed paragraph boundary, retaining visible structure with the least invented formatting.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the capability-driven fallback layer whose semantic policy would own this decision.
